commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' 0 - 2 Goal! Keane Lewis-Potter manages to prod the ball to Mathias Jensen (Brentford) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the top left corner. 0:2.
90+2' What a miskick by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
90+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mathias Jensen (Brentford) comes onto the pitch so that Jordan Henderson can be given a rest.
90' Today's referee Andy Madley rightly decides to book Jordan Henderson (Brentford) for his harsh tackle.
90' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul. West Ham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
86' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) superbly rides the challenge and bends a shot in from distance that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
85' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
85' The game is interrupted. One of the players from West Ham is cautioned for aggressive play. Brentford are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
80' Igor Thiago (Brentford) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
75' Keith Andrews has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) replacing Dango Ouattara.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikkel Damsgaard trots off the pitch and is replaced by Vitaly Janelt (Brentford).
74' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:5.
74' Brentford keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
72' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) picks up a pass, beats his marker but shoots high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
71' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Tomas Soucek will be replaced by Guido Rodriguez (West Ham).
70' West Ham couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Caoimhin Kelleher (Brentford) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
67' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) for a tough tackle.
67' Flag up against Igor Thiago (Brentford). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
66' Michael Kayode (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but Alphonse Areola comes off his line to gather the ball.
65' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) sends a long ball in, but Caoimhin Kelleher comfortably gathers the ball.
62' Kevin Schade (Brentford) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
61' Substitution. Callum Marshall (West Ham) on for Andrew Irving.
61' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
61' Corner kick. Brentford will have an opportunity.
61' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The linesman makes the right call and Brentford will have a corner.
56' The resulting corner from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
55' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.

50' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) tries his luck from long range, but it doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
47' Brentford have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' Nuno Espirito Santo has made a change at the break. Konstantinos Mavropanos has come on in place of Mateus Fernandes (West Ham).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Oliver Scarles (West Ham) comes off for El Hadji Malick Diouf.
46' Nuno Espirito Santo makes a switch. Aaron Wan-Bissaka is coming on in place of Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+10' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+10' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Brentford players look gutted.
45+8' The Brentford players halt their celebrations as referee Andy Madley makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45+7' It's in the back of the net! Mikkel Damsgaard is the provider as he slips the ball to Igor Thiago (Brentford) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 0:2.
45+6' A quickly taken corner by West Ham.
45+6' West Ham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner.

45+5' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Caoimhin Kelleher thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The ball goes behind for a corner. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
43' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Kevin Schade laid the ball off to Igor Thiago (Brentford), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
42' Brentford earn a corner.

40' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
39' The referee signals a corner kick to Brentford.
37' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' 35:65 – the ratio of ball possession.
33' Brentford take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
33' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brentford.
32' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Now Brentford have a corner.
32' Alphonse Areola pulls off a great save to block a header from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) after a nice lofted cross.
31' Igor Thiago (Brentford) wastes a huge chance as he sends a first-time shot from inside the penalty area straight onto the crossbar!
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.
27' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
25' The free kick picks out Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) in space, but his close-range header flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
25' Another situation results in a direct free kick for Brentford.
21' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
19' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) beautifully controls an overhit pass, beats an opponent but hits a weak shot at goal that sails high over the bar.
19' Igor Thiago (Brentford) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
17' Some great controlled play and passing from Brentford. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
16' The West Ham players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. It's a throw-in for Brentford.
11' A cross from a corner kick by West Ham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
11' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for West Ham.

9' Kevin Schade (Brentford) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alphonse Areola, who pulls off a comfortable save!
7' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
6' Michael Kayode (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
5' Kevin Schade (Brentford) misses a big chance as his shot goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
3' West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
2' The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
2' West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
